messages:
Samira (Sales): Hey team — AcmeHealth is asking for final access control evidence to close the POC. They specifically want: SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC role matrix, and an example audit log showing a service account token creation. Can we assemble a minimal bundle by EOD?
Jordan - SE: I can draft the RBAC matrix and sample SAML metadata. Do they need step-by-step screenshots or just exported configs?
Samira (Sales): They said 'evidence artifacts suitable for vendor risk team' — screenshots + exported configs preferred. Also they asked where to validate SAML metadata (entity ID + cert).
Alex S.: For SAML metadata, we can provide the IdP/SP metadata XML and a short verification snippet. Example verification we use in CI: 
```
# verify cert thumbprint matches
openssl x509 -in sp_cert.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha256
# check entityID in metadata
xmllint --xpath 'string(//EntityDescriptor/@entityID)' sp-metadata.xml
```
Jordan - SE: I'll attach a sanitized sp-metadata.xml (remove real certs) and a screenshot of the Redwood Console > Auth > SSO mapping showing attribute mapping.
Mike (Security): For MFA enforcement, we need to show policy and an auth log sample showing challenge enforcement. I can pull a 30-day sample from the audit logs with PII redacted. We'll include a short writeup: policy name, enforcement date, and scope (admin vs user).
Samira (Sales): Great. Also customer asked about least-privilege for service accounts — they'd like an example terraform snippet showing scoped role binding. Jordan, can you add that?
Jordan - SE: Yep. I'll include a tiny Terraform example and the role definition we recommend (compute:invoke, models:infer limited perms). Snippet: 
```
resource "redwood_role" "svc_infer" {
  name = "svc.infer"
  permissions = ["models.infer", "jobs.submit"]
}
```
VendorRiskBot: Automated checklist: Received request: access-control-evidence. Required items: [SAML metadata, MFA policy, RBAC matrix, Audit log sample, Service-account role sample]. Missing: none (in progress). ETA: 2026-03-05 18:00 UTC.
Alex S.: For the audit log sample, I'll redact IPs and user IDs, include only event types: token.create, auth.challenge, role.assign. We'll prepend a short mapping doc explaining field names.
Samira (Sales): Can we also add a one-paragraph security narrative for the SIG/CAIQ reviewers explaining our SSO + MFA + RBAC posture? They want a plain english summary.
Mike (Security): I'll write the narrative: outline SAML SSO with IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows, MFA required for privileged roles, RBAC enforced via scoped roles, and automated audits + alerting. Keep it 3-4 sentences.
Jordan - SE: Last ask from Acme — they want a contact for on-call during endpoint integration. Samira, should we give them the solutions-eng rotation alias or a named SE?
Samira (Sales): Give them the rotation alias (se-rotation@redwood) and CC Jordan for handoff. Ok team — plan: Jordan = metadata + RBAC + terraform + screenshots; Alex = audit logs + verification snippets; Mike = MFA policy + narrative. I'll package to a secure share and notify customer. Target upload by 18:00 UTC today. :thumbsup:
Jordan - SE: On it. Will ping when uploads are in secure bucket.
Alex S.: Uploading redacted logs in 30m.
Mike (Security): Drafting narrative now, will post to thread when ready.
Samira (Sales): Thanks — will update the POC tracker and tell Acme the ETA.
VendorRiskBot: File upload event detected (secure-share). Files: rbac_matrix.xlsx, sp-metadata.xml, audit_sample_redacted.json, mfa_policy.pdf, svc_role.tf. Uploaded by Jordan.
